settings_descriptions.Auctions.defaultDivider: Starting bid = base price divided by this value.
settings_descriptions.Auctions.enabled: Dealerships can buy stock at the recurring system auctions.
settings_descriptions.Auctions.liveTime: Minutes an auction stays live for bids.
settings_descriptions.Auctions.randomAuctionAmount.max: Most random auctions that can be created per batch.
settings_descriptions.Auctions.randomAuctionAmount.min: Least amount of random auctions created per batch.
settings_descriptions.Auctions.randomAuctionTime: Every X minutes the system creates a batch of random auctions.
settings_descriptions.BlueBook.basePct: A used vehicle starts at this percentage of its base price.
settings_descriptions.BlueBook.enabled: Appraisals and the over-book cap on trade-ins and preowned offers. Off means free negotiation.
settings_descriptions.BlueBook.floorPct: The book value never drops below this percentage of the base price.
settings_descriptions.BlueBook.maxOverPct: How far above the book value an employee can go when valuing a customer vehicle, for trade-ins and preowned offers alike.
settings_descriptions.BlueBook.perOwnerPct: Each sale, trade or repossession on the vehicle history lowers the book value by this much.
settings_descriptions.Catalogue.classFilter: Adds a second level filter by performance class (S, A, B...) under each category in the catalogue.
settings_descriptions.Catalogue.stockOnly: The catalogue only lists vehicles the dealership currently holds. Off shows the full catalogue, with the out of stock ones marked as such. Automatic dealerships always show everything assigned to them.
settings_descriptions.CatalogueFinancing.enabled: Dealerships without an owner can finance vehicles bought from their catalogue.
settings_descriptions.CatalogueFinancing.interestPct: Added on top of the price when a catalogue purchase is financed.
settings_descriptions.CatalogueFinancing.maxContracts: Active financed purchases a single player can hold across these dealerships.
settings_descriptions.CatalogueFinancing.maxPayments: Longest payment plan a catalogue purchase can pick.
settings_descriptions.CivilAuctions.enabled: Dealerships can auction stock to the public through the Motors app.
settings_descriptions.Dealership.autoCloseHours: Closes a dealership when nobody has opened its app for this long. 0 turns it off.
settings_descriptions.Debug.enabled: Prints every money flow and rejection reason to the server and client consoles. Turn it on to diagnose, off on a busy server.
settings_descriptions.Insurance.deductiblePct: Percentage of the insured value the customer pays to get a replacement.
settings_descriptions.Insurance.employeeCommissionPct: Percentage of the premium automatically given to the employee.
settings_descriptions.Insurance.enabled: Dealerships can sell coverage when delivering a vehicle.
settings_descriptions.Insurance.premiumPct: Cost of a policy as percentage of the sale price, scaled to the coverage length.
settings_descriptions.OfflineSales.enabled: Master switch, dealerships still need their own toggle on.
settings_descriptions.OfflineSales.markupPct: Extra percentage charged when buying without an employee.
settings_descriptions.OfflineSales.minMarkupPct: How far the Marketing upgrade can bring the markup down.
settings_descriptions.Orders.instantDelivery: Deliver orders instantly instead of requiring the truck job.
settings_descriptions.Orders.vehiclesPerOrder: Max units a dealership can request in a single order.
settings_descriptions.Payments.lateDays: Days since the last payment before it shows as late.
settings_descriptions.Payments.maxPayments: Max number of payments allowed for a vehicle lease.
settings_descriptions.Payments.repossessDays: Days without paying before the dealership can repossess the vehicle.
settings_descriptions.Posts.enabled: Dealerships can publish announcements on their Motors page.
settings_descriptions.PublicApp.enabled: The customer app on the laptop. Turning it off blocks its features right away; the icon disappears on the next resource restart.
settings_descriptions.Ratings.enabled: Customers can rate the service 1 to 5 stars and averages show on the dealership pages.
settings_descriptions.Rentals.allowEarlyReturn: Dealerships can take a rented vehicle back before the rental expires.
settings_descriptions.Rentals.employeeCommissionPct: Percentage of the rent automatically given to the employee.
settings_descriptions.Rentals.enabled: Dealerships can rent vehicles out. Active rentals keep running and can still be returned.
settings_descriptions.Rentals.expiredToPreowned: Move vehicles to preowned when the rental expires instead of back to stock.
settings_descriptions.Rentals.maxDays: Longest period a dealership can rent out a vehicle.
settings_descriptions.Rentals.minPricePct: Minimum daily price as percentage of the vehicle base price.
settings_descriptions.SellPoint.buybackPct: The instant offer is this percentage of the vehicle's blue book value.
settings_descriptions.SellPoint.enabled: Customers can drive their vehicle to a sell point and sell it to the dealership on the spot.
settings_descriptions.Sells.allowSelfDeals: Employees can sell, rent and buy from themselves. Off by default, turn it on only to test.
settings_descriptions.Sells.defaultMarkupPct: Percentage added on top of the base price when a vehicle gets its first sell price.
settings_descriptions.Sells.employeeCommissionPct: Percentage of the sale automatically given to the employee.
settings_descriptions.Sells.financingEnabled: Employee sales can be split into payment plans. Off forces every sale to a single payment; existing contracts keep running.
settings_descriptions.Sells.financingPaymentCommissionPct: Commission for the seller when a client pays a financing installment.
settings_descriptions.Sells.teleportOnPurchase: Put the buyer straight into the driver seat when their vehicle is delivered. Skipped when the player is not next to the delivery spot.
settings_descriptions.Showroom.stockOnly: Employees can only display vehicles the dealership actually holds in its warehouse. Automatic dealerships always offer everything assigned to them.
settings_descriptions.TestDrive.bucket: Move the customer and the test vehicle to their own routing bucket, so the car cannot be handed to someone else or used against other players. Catalogue test drives only, an employee testing from the app stays in the world with everyone else. Leave it off if another resource on your server manages routing buckets.
settings_descriptions.TestDrive.bucketBase: First routing bucket id used by private catalogue test drives. Move it if another resource on your server already uses this range.
settings_descriptions.TestDrive.enabled: Master switch for test drives everywhere: the app, the catalogue and open test points.
settings_descriptions.TestDrive.isOpen: Allow customers to test drive without an employee.
settings_descriptions.TestDrive.needsStock: Dealerships need available stock to test drive a vehicle.
settings_descriptions.TestDrive.teleport: Put the customer straight into the driver seat when the test vehicle spawns. Catalogue test drives only: one started by an employee from the app always spawns at the test spot and leaves them where they stand.
settings_descriptions.TestDrive.time: Total time before the test vehicle gets deleted by the server.
settings_descriptions.TradeIns.enabled: Customers can hand over their vehicle as part of payment when buying.
settings_descriptions.Upgrades.automaticUnlocked: Dealerships flagged as automatic behave as if every upgrade were already at its last level.
settings_descriptions.Upgrades.enabled: The upgrade tree dealerships buy with company funds. Upgrades already purchased keep their effect.
settings_descriptions.VehicleHistory.enabled: Employees can read the per-plate history report. Events keep being recorded either way.

admin.rentals_only_desc: The dealership can order stock, buy preowned and rent vehicles out, but it cannot sell them. Sales, catalogue purchases, public auctions and financing are closed.
admin.offline_rentals_desc: Customers can rent from the catalogue with no employee around, while the dealership is closed (always, for automatic ones). Priced per model from the warehouse.
